text: Bitcoin is pulling back slightly while Ethereum holds steady, suggesting some consolidation at current levels rather than broad panic. The Fear & Greed index at 74 and rising indicates sustained optimism, though Bitcoin's dominance at 58.3% shows money isn't rotating uniformly across alts—most are declining. Volume at $155B is moderate, which combined with mixed directional signals points to a market waiting for the next catalyst rather than displaying conviction in either direction.
